title: Bias in the Picture: Benchmarking VLMs with Social-Cue News Images and LLM-as-Judge Assessment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating VLM responses to real-world news images and open-ended questions using an LLM-as-judge (GPT-4o) to score outputs for stereotyping and prejudice based on visible age cues.
